title: A Lament for Egypt

questions.question: What is Ezekiel commanded to wail concerning the day of the Lord?
options: "Alas for the day! For the day is near, the day of the Lord is near; it will be a day of clouds..."
"Let the stars be darkened, for the sword comes upon Egypt!"
"Weep for the Pharaoh, for he is fallen!"
"Prepare for battle, for the Chaldeans approach!"
questions.correctAnswer: "Alas for the day! For the day is near, the day of the Lord is near; it will be a day of clouds..."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 30:2-3 (ESV): "Wail, 'Alas for the day!' For the day is near, the day of the Lord is near; it will be a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations."

questions.question: When the sword comes upon Egypt, who will be in anguish when the slain fall in Egypt?
options: Cush (Ethiopia)
Babylon
Edom
Philistia
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 30:4 (ESV): "A sword shall come upon Egypt, and anguish shall be in Cush, when the slain fall in Egypt..."

questions.question: Who will fall with Egypt by the sword?
options: Cush, and Put, and Lud, and all Arabia, and Libya, and the people of the land that is in league
Only the hired soldiers from Greece
The army of Judah fleeing there
The merchants of Tyre who traded with them
questions.correctAnswer: Cush, and Put, and Lud, and all Arabia, and Libya, and the people of the land that is in league
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 30:5 (ESV): "Cush, and Put, and Lud, and all Arabia, and Libya, and the people of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword."

questions.question: What will happen to the pride of Egypt's power?
options: It shall come down; from Migdol to Syene they shall fall within her by the sword
It will be crushed beneath the wheels of chariots
It shall be hidden in the tombs of the fathers
It will be carried as treasure to Babylon
questions.correctAnswer: It shall come down; from Migdol to Syene they shall fall within her by the sword
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 30:6 (ESV): "Those who support Egypt shall fall, and her proud might shall come down; from Migdol to Syene they shall fall within her by the sword, declares the Lord God."

questions.question: How will God destroy Egypt's idols and images according to verse 13?
options: "I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis"
"I will melt the golden calves and give them to Babylon"
"I will strike the sphinx with lightning"
"I will bury them under the desert sands"
questions.correctAnswer: "I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 30:13 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord God: I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis;"

questions.question: According to verse 13, who shall there never again be in the land of Egypt?
options: A prince of the land of Egypt
A living god
A Hebrew slave
A wealthy merchant
questions.correctAnswer: A prince of the land of Egypt
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 30:13 (ESV): "there shall no longer be a prince from the land of Egypt; so I will put fear in the land of Egypt."

questions.question: Into whose hand does God say He will put an end to the wealth of Egypt?
options: The hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon
The hand of the king of Assyria
The hand of a coalition of small nations
The hand of the Roman Empire
questions.correctAnswer: The hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 30:10 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord God: I will put an end to the wealth of Egypt, by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon."

questions.question: Who will Nebuchadnezzar bring with him to destroy the land?
options: He and his people with him, the most ruthless of nations
A swarm of locusts from the east
The princes of Elam and Media
He will come alone with fire from heaven
questions.correctAnswer: He and his people with him, the most ruthless of nations
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 30:11 (ESV): "He and his people with him, the most ruthless of nations, shall be brought in to destroy the land, and they shall draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain."

questions.question: What will God do to the canals of the Nile?
options: "I will dry up the Nile"
"I will turn them to blood"
"I will make them overflow their banks and drown the cities"
"I will fill them with frogs"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 30:12 (ESV): "And I will dry up the Nile and will sell the land into the hand of evil men; I will bring desolation upon the land and everything in it, by the hand of foreigners; I am the Lord; I have spoken."

questions.question: What will happen to the young men of On (Heliopolis) and of Pi-beseth (Bubastis)?
options: They shall fall by the sword, and the women shall go into captivity
They will be forced to rebuild the walls
They will rebel and flee to the mountains
They will join the Babylonian army
questions.correctAnswer: They shall fall by the sword, and the women shall go into captivity
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 30:17 (ESV): "The young men of On and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword, and the women shall go into captivity."

questions.question: Later in the chapter, what has God broken of Pharaoh king of Egypt?
options: The arm of Pharaoh
The staff of his pride
The chariot wheel
His golden crown
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 30:21 (ESV): "Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and behold, it has not been bound up, to heal it by binding it with a bandage, so that it may become strong to wield the sword."

questions.question: Because God will break both of Pharaoh's arms—the strong one and the broken one—what will happen?
options: I will make the sword fall from his hand
He will never be able to eat again
He will bow his knees to Babylon in submission
His shield will become too heavy to lift
questions.correctAnswer: I will make the sword fall from his hand
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 30:22 (ESV): "Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, both the strong arm and the one that was broken, and I will make the sword fall from his hand."

questions.question: While God breaks the arms of Pharaoh, whose arms will he strengthen?
options: The arms of the king of Babylon
The arms of the Israelites in exile
The arms of the king of Assyria
The arms of the Philistines
questions.correctAnswer: The arms of the king of Babylon
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 30:24 (ESV): "And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put my sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before him..."

questions.question: What weapon will God put into the hand of the king of Babylon?
options: His sword (God's sword)
A golden sceptre
An iron rod
A bow of bronze
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 30:24-25 (ESV): "I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put my sword in his hand... when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he stretches it out against the land of Egypt"

questions.question: What is the ultimate purpose of this judgment upon Egypt, stated several times (e.g., vv. 8, 19, 25, 26)?
options: "Then they will know that I am the Lord"
"To avenge the slavery of Israel"
"To fulfill the covenant of Abraham"
"To enrich the king of Babylon"
questions.correctAnswer: "Then they will know that I am the Lord"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 30:26 (ESV): "I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them through the countries. Then they will know that I am the Lord."

key_verse_text: "And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put my sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before him like a man mortally wounded."
